title: Neutral Be₂ in the model
statement:
What does the elementary valence MO count predict for neutral Be₂?

[_]{a}

choices: Bond order zero and all electrons paired
Bond order one and all electrons paired
Bond order zero and two unpaired electrons
Bond order two and two unpaired electrons
explanations: Equal bonding and antibonding occupations cancel in this model.
This counts all four valence electrons as bonding.

hints: Each Be contributes two valence electrons.
Four electrons fill σ₂s and σ*₂s.
Count their effects with opposite signs.
solution: Each Be contributes two valence electrons. Four electrons fill σ₂s and σ*₂s. Count their effects with opposite signs. Equal bonding and antibonding occupations cancel in this model.
